regions.name: National
regions.where: Whole country (calendar has no regional titles and no locator map)

planting.name: Land prep., planting, weeding: irrigated crops

regions.notes: Rainy season shaded mid-Oct to mid-Apr. Lean box drawn in two pieces (Dec and Jan to mid-Mar), recorded as one Dec-Mar season. The irrigated-crops bar combines land preparation, planting and weeding (May to mid-Sep). Cotton sales (May-Aug) and tobacco sales (Apr-Sep) are sales bars, not harvest bars, so not recorded. Green harvest (mid-Mar to Apr), labour and milk bars not recorded. Edges at or near a mid-month tick, counted as covering the month (share of that month covered in brackets): Rainy Season (Apr 50%, Oct 50%); Lean Season (Mar 48%); Land prep., planting, weeding: irrigated crops (Sep 49%).

assign.method: Single national calendar with no regional titles; all three regions mapped to 'national'.

transcriber_notes: Rainy-season edges and the lean-season end sit on mid-month ticks and were counted (see notes).
